results.text: We bought the new dishwasher in March 2024 from the appliance store on Main Street — the Bosch 300 series. The receipt is in the documents folder.
Noted. The Bosch 300 series has a two-year manufacturer warranty, so it is covered until March 2026. I will remind you a month before it ends.
Can you remember that the dishwasher rinse aid is kept under the sink, left side?
